lead.headline: The 1-7 team is winning with one quarterback
lead.dek: Santa Clara’s Finest started Sunday with a locked zero at quarterback and a long-shot label. After the early games it leads deeboliciouskins 130.64 to 110.34 and is 65.4% to win, while deeboliciouskins carries a busted lineup of its own: George Pickens, Out, started at receiver.
lead.pull: Santa Clara’s Finest 130.64, deeboliciouskins 110.34. One player left against two.
body: I’ve covered Santa Clara’s Finest for nine weeks, and I’ve written its obituary for most of them. This morning the Report had deeboliciouskins as the clear favorite. Then the early window happened, and the 1-7 team walked out of it leading 130.64 to 110.34. The odds flipped with it: Santa Clara’s Finest 65.4%, deeboliciouskins 34.6%.

This was done with one quarterback. Lamar Jackson’s 0.0 from Thursday is still sitting in the first QB slot, and it didn’t matter. Kenneth Walker III went for 36.3 against a 21.74 projection. Joe Burrow added 29.54. The kicker, Spencer Shrader, put up 16.0. And the two lineup calls this front office made before kickoff both cashed: Denzel Boston, in for the injured Garrett Wilson, scored 15.8, and Blake Corum gave the flex 11.8.

Now the other side of the ledger, and it’s a big one. George Pickens was Out this morning and stayed in the deeboliciouskins lineup at receiver. His game is final, the slot is locked, and it’s a 0.0. DJ Moore, projected for 12.78, is still on the bench. A correction from this desk: this morning’s brief said that swap could wait for Monday. It couldn’t. The slot locked the moment Pickens’ game kicked off.

deeboliciouskins did plenty right. Ja’Marr Chase scored 31.5, Patrick Mahomes 16.48, Jayden Daniels 14.36, the Kansas City defense 12.0. It just did it with ten starters instead of eleven, against a team doing it with ten starters instead of eleven. One of those zeros was an injury on Thursday. The other was still fixable at breakfast.

Here’s what’s left. deeboliciouskins has two: D’Andre Swift, projected for 18.99, on Sunday night, and Jason Myers, kicking now. Santa Clara’s Finest has one: Colston Loveland, at 11.0, in the same Sunday night game as Swift. The live projection is 141.64 to 135.61, Finest. My pick flips with the math. Santa Clara’s Finest. Write it down, because I may not get to write it again.

quick_hits.headline: Pickens started, Pickens sat, Pickens scored 0.0
quick_hits.body: George Pickens was Out and in the deeboliciouskins lineup when his game kicked off, and that WR slot is now a locked 0.0. DJ Moore, 12.78 projected, watches from the bench. deeboliciouskins trails 130.64 to 110.34 and is 34.6% to win.

quick_hits.headline: Puka Nacua turned a lead into a verdict
quick_hits.body: Cherry Blossom leads AB81 143.08 to 98.56, and the win odds are 98.8%. Puka Nacua scored 35.0, Tee Higgins finished at 20.2, Jonah Coleman 18.8, Travis Kelce 17.3, Jake Bates 15.0. Christian McCaffrey and Brock Bowers are still playing. The 7-1 team is about to have company at the top.

quick_hits.headline: AB81 kept Lemon over Kittle, and it was right
quick_hits.body: The Kittle shuffle never happened. Makai Lemon scored 12.1 in the lineup, George Kittle scored 6.1 on the bench, so the front office won the argument this desk was having with it. It just can’t win the game: AB81 has Jaxon Smith-Njigba, at 4.5, and Rhamondre Stevenson left and is 1.2% to win.

quick_hits.headline: Poochinski is up 139.3 to 63.2
quick_hits.body: CeeDee Lamb scored 33.5, Javonte Williams 22.4, Dak Prescott 19.5, and Chris Olave, the morning’s WR call, 16.8. Maye I touch your TDs? has six starters left, but its quarterbacks are Brock Purdy at 3.04 and Drake Maye at -0.44. Poochinski, 90%.

quick_hits.headline: Big Stric Energy is down big and still alive
quick_hits.body: Bad things man bad things leads 98.62 to 49.2, but Big Stric Energy has eight starters left to five, and Josh Allen and Justin Jefferson haven’t played. The live projection is 161.47 to 156.35. Bad things, 56.7%. This is the one that goes to Monday.

quick_hits.headline: Bad things’ best quarterback was on the bench
quick_hits.body: Tyler Shough scored 19.7 on the Bad things bench. Malik Willis started and scored 4.82. Bijan Robinson’s 26.7 covered for a lot, but in a matchup this close, that’s a choice that could come back around on Monday night.

w9-m1.headline: Bad things banked it. Big Stric still has Allen and Jefferson.
w9-m1.blurb: 98.62 to 49.2, 161.47 to 156.35 on the live projection. Big Stric Energy has five playing now plus Allen, Jefferson and Chase McLaughlin to come; Bad things has James Cook III, the Chicago defense, and three in the late games. Bad things, 56.7%, and not by much.

w9-m2.headline: The Finest leads with one quarterback
w9-m2.blurb: 130.64 to 110.34, 141.64 to 135.61 projected. deeboliciouskins needs D’Andre Swift, at 18.99, to outrun Colston Loveland, at 11.0, by enough to cover the gap, with Pickens’ 0.0 locked in. Santa Clara’s Finest, 65.4%.

w9-m3.headline: Poochinski is cruising
w9-m3.blurb: 139.3 to 63.2, 180.0 to 147.81 projected. Maye I touch your TDs? has six starters left and needs every one of them to explode. Poochinski still has Caleb Williams and Luther Burden III on Sunday night. Poochinski, 90%.

w9-m4.headline: Cherry Blossom is about to beat the 7-1 team
w9-m4.blurb: 143.08 to 98.56, 175.17 to 131.97 projected. AB81 has two players left and needs about a week’s worth from them. Cherry Blossom, 98.8%.

w9-r7-s4.headline: The Finest’s WR call: Boston in, and he scored 15.8
w9-r7-s4.blurb: Garrett Wilson was Out. Denzel Boston, projected for 10.75, took the spot and beat it. That call is part of why the 1-7 team is leading.

w9-r2-s4.headline: Poochinski’s WR call: Olave in, 16.8
w9-r2-s4.blurb: Chris Olave over Chris Godwin Jr. Olave scored 16.8. Godwin, on the bench, scored 0.0. Clean.

w9-r6-s0.headline: deeboliciouskins’ QB call: Mahomes, 16.48
w9-r6-s0.blurb: Kyler Murray sat, Patrick Mahomes started and scored 16.48. That one was handled. The receiver slot was not.

alert_notes.6: George Pickens started at receiver and his team played without him. The slot is locked at 0.0 and DJ Moore, 12.78 projected, is on the bench, in a game deeboliciouskins trails.
alert_notes.7: Lamar Jackson started at quarterback and his team played without him on Thursday. That 0.0 is locked, and the Finest leads anyway.
